Needs changes before merge.

The J limits keep the R1 pass count equal to the record's pass count. The post rejects records that the grid cannot represent. No UI files changed.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main c785c14bd1c726d0042b7c5b98f0a13d5b7b5a5d:

- Build: PASS. The three app test suites compiled with `cargo test --no-run`.
- App tests: PASS. `lathe_post_tormach`: 8; `lathe_post_tormach_g76_ladder`: 2; `lathe_post_tormach_thread`: 7.
- Post tests: PASS. Library: 46; `recorded_streams`: 12; `script_tormach_lathe`: 11.
- Clippy: PASS. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Safety mutation 1: remove `if (j < lo) j = lo;`. Both ladder tests FAIL. The inch output has four passes instead of three.
- Safety mutation 2: remove `j <= hi` from the rejection condition. The inch rejection test FAILS.
- After restoration: all 9 ladder and thread tests PASS. No mutation remains.

I checked the changed NC file line by line. Only line 12 changes: J0.0314 becomes J0.0315. With K0.0944, the calculated R1 pass count changes from four to three. P, Z, I, K, R, Q, H and all other lines stay the same. The root depth stays the same. The [LinuxCNC G76 reference](https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/g-code.html#gcode:g76) specifies constant depth for R1 and diameter values for J and K under G7. These checks do not replace a control test.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/thread_g76_inch.nc:12` — Run this changed golden in the PathPilot Hub 8L simulator. Record completion to M30, the alarm result, and the three cutting depths. Issue #1619 requires a new Hub run. The PR body states that this run is not done. The earlier run used J0.0314 and does not test J0.0315.

The local gate plan was inspected, but the full quick or batch gate was not run. The tests above cover the changed post and its app path. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review requests a PathPilot Hub 8L simulator run of thread_g76_inch.nc with J0.0315. This session has no browser or computer-control tool to operate Hub. I could not verify completion to M30, alarms, or the three cutting depths.

No code or tests changed. The head remains 8574c0dd5bc73160a5b0f0f0b4da7f405ec55074. No gate was run because the requested external validation is blocked. The temporary worktree was removed. Re-review is still needed after the Hub run evidence is recorded.

PathPilot Hub run on the 8L lathe simulator (PathPilot v2.14.4, 8LSM), 2026-11-14 21:55-21:59 local.

Files:
- `thread_g76_inch_J0315.nc`: main's `tormach-lathe/thread_g76_inch.nc` golden (with #1667's one-axis approach) plus this PR's single change, `J0.0315`. This PR's own head is from before #1667, so its file still has the old diagonal approach. After it merges with main, the program is this file.
- `reference_main_J0314.nc`: main as it is today, `J0.0314`.

Setup: G54 Z moved 0.1 in toward the chuck (from -4.5040 to -4.6040). With the old Z zero, the load warned "Program exceeds machine maximum on Z axis by 0.0124 in" for the G30 and G0 Z1.5748 moves. That is a simulator setup note, not a program fault.

Results:
- `thread_g76_inch_J0315.nc`: loaded with no warning, ran to M30, no alarm. Cycle time 00:00:03, last line 19.
- `reference_main_J0314.nc`: loaded with no warning, ran to M30, no alarm. Cycle time 00:01:51, last line 19. Most of that time was the manual "Change tool to T1" prompt.

The G76 line with `J0.0315 K0.0944 R1` is accepted by PathPilot and runs to the end. The preview showed the threading passes from the start point to Z0.315, and the departure went out in X, then Z, then G30. I did not count the depth passes in the preview.

The latest review requests a PathPilot Hub 8L run with J0.0315 and records of M30 completion, alarms, and three cutting depths.

The later Hub report confirms M30 completion without alarms. It does not record the three cutting depths. This session has no browser or computer-control tool to obtain those readings. The requested validation remains incomplete.

The main merge stopped before file changes because Git has no committer identity configured. No code, tests, labels, or commits changed. No mutation check, quick gate, or clippy check ran.

The head remains 8574c0dd5bc73160a5b0f0f0b4da7f405ec55074. Please re-review after the three Hub cutting depths are recorded and the branch refresh passes its checks.

Pass count, from the LinuxCNC G76 rule for the degression `R1` (constant depth per pass: pass n cuts to n × J, and the last pass is limited to K), with K0.0944:
- `J0.0315` (this PR): 0.0315, 0.0630, 0.0944 (the third pass reaches K). That is 3 passes, the same as the record.
- `J0.0314` (main): 0.0314, 0.0628, 0.0942, then a 4th pass of 0.0002 to reach 0.0944. That is 4 passes.

The Hub run (comment above) shows PathPilot accepts `J0.0315 K0.0944 R1` and runs it to M30 with no alarm. The pass depths above come from the G76 rule, not from a reading in the simulator. If a reviewer needs the simulator count too, it can be counted with Single Block on the 8L simulator.

Merged upstream/main into this branch. The inch golden keeps J0.0315 and the separate X and Z approach moves.

New head: e0c2e069f3e8adb62521fa7c61d544a746faa236.

Quick gate: PASS. Clippy: PASS for camcraft-app and camcraft-post, all targets, with warnings denied.

The G30, ladder, and thread suites pass all 13 tests. A diagonal approach mutation fails the G30 and thread pins. Removing the J lower clamp fails both ladder pins. After restoration, all 13 tests pass. The missing-stock and clearance refusals also pass.

The earlier Hub report confirms M30 completion with no alarm. It does not give the three measured cutting depths. No simulator session is connected here. This review finding remains open.

Please re-review the branch refresh. The three cutting depths still need a simulator check.

Needs changes before merge.

The branch refresh keeps the separate X and Z approach moves from main. It also keeps J0.0315 and the X-before-Z test. The grid limits preserve the record's pass count or reject the record by name. No UI files changed.

Local results against upstream/main `03dc12c6af2bf1b39125d8eec5d60cf6d682170b`:

- Trial merge: PASS. The head already contains this main commit.
- Build: PASS. `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lathe_post_tormach --test lathe_post_tormach_g76_ladder --test lathe_post_tormach_thread --no-run`.
- App tests: PASS. `lathe_post_tormach`: 8; `lathe_post_tormach_g76_ladder`: 2; `lathe_post_tormach_thread`: 7.
- Post tests: PASS. Library: 54; `recorded_streams`: 12; `script_tormach_lathe`: 11.
- Clippy: PASS. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Safety mutation 1: remove `if (j < lo) j = lo;`. Both ladder tests FAIL. The inch output cuts four passes instead of three.
- Safety mutation 2: remove `j <= hi &&` from the rejection condition. The inch refusal test FAILS because the post accepts the record.
- After restoration: all 9 ladder and thread tests PASS. `git diff --exit-code` confirms that no mutation remains.

I checked all 19 lines of the inch NC golden against main. Only line 13 changes: J0.0314 becomes J0.0315. P, Z, I, K, R, Q, H and all other lines stay the same. The separate X and Z approach moves stay in place. The root depth stays the same. The mm golden has no change.

The [LinuxCNC G76 reference](https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/g-code.html#gcode:g76) specifies diameter values under G7 and constant depth for R1. The calculated inch depths are 0.0315, 0.0630 and 0.0944. These calculations do not provide simulator readings.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/thread_g76_inch.nc:13` — Record the three cutting depths from the PathPilot Hub 8L simulator. The previous review requested these readings. The later Hub report confirms M30 completion without alarms, but states that the passes were not counted. The later depth list comes from calculation. The latest author comment also states that this simulator check remains open. Add the observed depths and pass count to complete this request.

The quick gate plan was inspected. The full quick and batch gates were not run. All builds, tests and mutations ran locally in the review worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review has one open finding: record the observed pass count and three cutting depths from PathPilot Hub 8L.

No simulator session is connected. This session has no browser or computer-control tool. I cannot obtain the requested simulator readings. The calculated depths do not complete this request.

No code, tests, or commits changed. The head remains e0c2e069f3e8adb62521fa7c61d544a746faa236. No mutation check, quick gate, or clippy check ran.

Please re-review after the observed pass count and three cutting depths are recorded.
